The veterinarians and nurses are all very caring and attentive, so I feel completely at ease leaving my cat in their care!

My cat doesn't mind going to the vet and goes without any worries!

I took my 10-year-old tabby cat, Jaki, for a health checkup. (It was his first visit.)
Both the veterinarian and the nurse were very kind and gentle, and even though my cat is easily frightened, the examination went smoothly without him making a fuss.
I was allowed to be present in the examination room during the abdominal ultrasound, and the explanation was easy to understand, and my questions were answered thoroughly.
It's also convenient that I can view the examination results and visit history through the app.
I would like to visit again for my younger cat's health checkup and vaccinations.
Thank you for your help today!

The female veterinarian was very kind and provided thorough treatment.

I brought my child with me, and the staff played with the dog while it was being treated, which was a great help.

We've been taking our cat in for checkups here.

First of all, right inside the building, the entrance to the waiting area is separated for cats and other animals, which shows great consideration.

The doctors and nurses are all very kind and caring, and it's the first time I've been to a hospital where their love for cats is so evident. Their explanations are very clear and thorough.

They've even taught us about treatment methods we've never heard of at other hospitals, and it's incredibly helpful to be able to view information such as the day's examination, costs, and weight through their dedicated app.

Also, this is the first hospital I've encountered that offers free nail trimming (as of August 2026; apologies if this changes in the future), which was a huge help.

Honestly, there are other hospitals closer to my home, but this is such a wonderful hospital that I would definitely want to go back to, even if it meant paying for a taxi.
The doctor and nurses were all kind and attentive!

The veterinarian and staff are incredibly kind, and I always feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care.

They are so flexible and adaptable to each situation, which is a huge help.

I've been to several animal hospitals before, but I feel that this one is by far the best in terms of service and trustworthiness.

I look forward to continuing to entrust my beloved family member to their care.
I really appreciate the thorough examinations you always provide!

I took my dog ​​in because he had swallowed something he shouldn't have.

Before I brought him in, we talked on the phone for a while, but in the end, they just avoided responsibility and didn't solve the problem.

If they couldn't handle it initially, they should have told me over the phone. I could have found someone who could help and taken care of him then, and I wasted my time. Ultimately, I had to get a second opinion, which took a long time, and my dog ​​didn't vomit. It was a wasted consultation, a wasted conversation, and a wasted expense.

Considering their skills and equipment, I felt they wouldn't be reliable in an emergency.

They should have just refused over the phone...
I should have left during the consultation.

Dear Mr./Ms. Shiuhail,

Thank you very much for your kind and high rating of our clinic.

All of our staff are extremely pleased and encouraged by your feedback.

We will continue to strive to provide even more attentive care and treatment so that we can remain a veterinary hospital where families can feel at ease.

Please feel free to contact our staff anytime if you have any concerns or problems.

We look forward to your continued patronage.

Peco Animal Hospital, Takanawadai

The first thing I looked for after moving was a veterinary clinic for senior cats.

After researching various options, I came here, and the doctor and staff have been incredibly kind and attentive.

Their explanations are easy to understand, and they've been a great source of support and advice.
They have a waiting room specifically for cats, and the staff are friendly, making it a pleasant place to visit.
Tailor-made treatment. The doctor is very thorough and trustworthy. The staff are also very pleasant, so I highly recommend it.

The doctors are so kind, they even give me snacks, and the clinic is so clean; I feel very relaxed here.
I hope to continue receiving care here for a long time to come. 🐱 …

We are taking care of our beloved 15-year-old cat's senior health issues (chronic kidney disease and hyperthyroidism) at this veterinary clinic.

Dr. Uchiyama, the clinic director, is always very attentive and listens carefully to our concerns. He explains the latest medical information and medications clearly and thoroughly, so we truly trust him. He even shares stories about his own cats when giving advice, which is very reassuring, and we feel confident entrusting our cat's treatment to him.

Furthermore, the nurses are always warm and kind, so our cat is able to relax during visits, and we are filled with gratitude every time we go.

This is a truly wonderful animal hospital that we highly recommend, where you can entrust your precious family member with peace of mind. We look forward to continuing to use your services.
Thank you for always taking such good care of my child. The cause of the vomiting, which was previously unknown, has now been identified through tests and treatment is underway.

The doctor and staff were all very kind, and I felt at ease having my cat examined. Their explanations were easy to understand, and I appreciate how gently they treated my cat. I would definitely like to use their services again if needed.

The doctors and staff are all very kind, and they carefully address even the smallest concerns during examinations, so I feel at ease bringing my pet here.

The clinic is very clean, and thanks to the dedicated waiting area for cats, my cat was able to relax.

Our previous cats and dogs were taken to various hospitals, but we often had to go early in the morning to get a numbered ticket and wait for hours. This hospital, however, operates on an appointment system, so there's no waiting, minimizing stress for our cats.

We appreciate the app-based booking system, which includes medical records and payment functions, as well as the availability of consultations via LINE. The advanced digitalization is a great help for pet owners.

The doctors and nurses are very kind and always praise our cats, which we appreciate.

The examinations are also very thorough and gentle.
They responded to my urgent request without showing any displeasure, and they also carefully monitored the situation, which was very helpful. It's rare to find such a good service.
This was my first visit, and I felt very at ease because I received a very thorough and kind examination! Thank you! I would like to come back again.

Even though I rushed in as an emergency, I received a thorough and careful examination.

The doctor and nurses were very kind.

Dear Yuri zou,

Thank you so much for your kind review.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any concerns about your pet's health or condition.

Peco Animal Hospital, Takanawadai

The teacher was very polite and I felt at ease! 
I look forward to working with you again!

This was my dog's first visit. He was nervous at first, but he was treated kindly by the doctor and nurses and given some delicious treats, and he quickly got used to the hospital! He was so happy when we left. Thank you so much!
I'm grateful for the kind and courteous service I received on my first visit. I'm glad I found a good hospital.

This was my first visit, but I received a thorough examination and treatment, and easy-to-understand instructions. 
I plan to continue using your services in the future.
I was very worried about my cat's treatment, but Dr. Uchiyama and the nurses were very kind and considerate, so I was able to visit the hospital with peace of mind. Thank you very much.
Although it was sudden, the quick response was very helpful, and the kind staff made me feel at ease.
That was great.

I took my dog ​​in for diarrhea and vomiting.

The doctor explained the medication and tests in detail, which made it easy to understand what medications were being used and what treatments were being performed. Also, when the IV drip was administered, everyone in the clinic encouraged my dog, which put both my dog ​​and me at ease.

It was my first time using this clinic, but my dog ​​was so calm and happy, even eating treats, by the time the examination was over, probably because he was petted and held so much. I would definitely like to use this clinic again if my dog ​​has any health problems in the future.

They are very kind and easy to talk to, and their thorough examinations and explanations alleviate my anxieties!

Thank you as always!

I will continue to come here! Thank you!
We've been taking care of them since they were puppies.

I was looking for a hospital where I could confidently care for my elderly dog ​​(a Shetland Sheepdog) when this clinic opened. I started bringing her in for vaccinations and acupuncture, and Dr. Uchiyama provided incredibly attentive care until she passed away last month from kidney failure. I was able to say goodbye to her without regrets.

When her condition became critical, they referred us to the main Harajuku clinic, and I was very reassured by the thorough sharing of treatment information and support between the main and Takanawadai branches.

In addition to detailed and thorough explanations of test results and treatment plans, I highly recommend this hospital, filled with the thoughtful care of Dr. Uchiyama and the staff!

Dr. Uchiyama and all the staff, thank you so much for everything.

My cat stopped urinating, so I frantically made an appointment and got her examined.

Dr. Uchiyama and the staff were very kind and welcoming, and I felt at ease while waiting. They also explained everything clearly.

I've never felt so relieved before.

I'm so grateful to have found such a good hospital. Thank you.

My dog ​​accidentally swallowed the tip of a yakitori skewer and I went to the clinic. There aren't many veterinary clinics open on Sundays, and because of the risk of accidentally ingesting something sharp, I was sent around to a number of different clinics. They responded to my call with the most appropriate response, and they treated my dog ​​with empathy for my concerns. Even after I got home that night, the doctor sent me a follow-up message. Even though it's a small clinic, the doctor and staff are so perfect, I've become a big fan! I look forward to continuing to use their services.
The hospital was very clean, and the staff were polite and reassuring. I think it's a hospital you can trust.

I visited this clinic for the first time because my 18-year-old cat was constipated.

The doctor and staff were very kind and easy to talk to. Thanks to their accurate diagnosis, my cat's constipation has gradually improved.

The clinic is also very clean, and they have treats and a separate waiting room for cats, showing great consideration for both dogs and cats.

I would definitely like to consult with them again if I have any further issues.

First of all, I'm glad I chose this hospital! The explanation and examination were very thorough, and all of my worries were resolved. Thank you very much. I'm grateful that there was an appointment available today.

My regular hospital was closed, so I had to take him in at short notice. The doctor and nurses were very kind, cheerful, and polite, which really soothed my anxious heart. I felt they were warm-hearted doctors who cared for both animals and their owners.

My 1-year-2-month-old miniature dachshund had a cough that wouldn't stop, so I took him to the clinic. The doctor and nurse were very kind and explained things carefully, so I was able to relax as a worried owner. His cough has also subsided! Thank you very much.
He gets very excited when other dogs are around, barking and wanting to play, which can be a challenge, but since they operate by appointment, I feel I can visit the clinic without worry.

We were introduced to Peco by a family member and decided to entrust them with the regular vet visits for our new puppy.

The doctor and staff were incredibly kind and attentive, not only regarding our puppy's health but also providing thorough consultations on daily training and any other concerns we had. We felt they were a very trustworthy hospital.

Even outside of scheduled appointments, we can consult directly with the doctor via LINE, receiving advice and even researching and answering specialized questions, which has been incredibly helpful.

Furthermore, daily care such as nail trimming, paw pad trimming, and ear cleaning are included in the consultation fee, and we are very grateful that these services are provided without any additional charges.

There are many animal hospitals in the neighborhood, and this one is relatively new, but we highly recommend it to anyone looking for a hospital they can rely on for long-term care.

I was looking for a veterinary clinic near my new home, and they were able to see my pet right away, even though it was the same day. The doctor and nurses were so kind and attentive that I would definitely like to continue going there in the future! The clinic is very clean, with separate waiting rooms for dogs and cats!
I visited the clinic when my puppy was in the puppy stage and had many worries, but the doctor listened to me very kindly and treated me with great care, which made me feel at ease.
The teachers are very kind. Thank you very much!

I visited your clinic for the first time for my kitten's checkup.
Thank you so much for your incredibly kind and thorough care. You carefully examined each symptom I was worried about, and I felt truly relieved.
The doctor was very gentle, and my kitten seemed relaxed during the examination.
I feel confident that I can bring my kitten here again in the future if anything comes up.
I look forward to continuing to use your services.

My tomboyish Chihuahua has been receiving care here. He was constantly sneezing, but after a few visits, he recovered. Since then, I've been relying on him for vaccinations and minor health issues.

The doctor is always smiling and kind, and the bright, cheerful atmosphere gives me peace of mind. Bookings are easy via the app, reception is done via tablet, and payments are smooth with a registered card. Having a system in place eliminates minor stress, which is very helpful.

I also appreciate the owner-friendly touches, such as routine care included in follow-up visit fees and special offers for bulk purchases of heartworm medication. The clinic is also clean, and I'm impressed by the constant air changes and thorough cleaning of the examination room.

This is a reliable veterinary clinic where you can visit with peace of mind.

I had a 6-month-old Chartreux kitten examined. I originally adopted him from a breeder because he had a persistent dermatitis on his forehead. A local veterinarian diagnosed him with chronic sinusitis. However, the causative bacteria was not identified, so I continued with Augmentin and quinolone medications as a blind treatment. Although the symptoms improved, the pus continued to flow. Therefore, I sought a second opinion. Dr. Uchiyama suspected an anaerobic infection. He cultured the pus for anaerobic bacteria, which proved correct. He cultured Bacteroides fragilis and administered Flagyl (metronidazole), which is the most sensitive to it. He also administered a local injection of minocycline, a dental drug. The pus flow stopped completely.

Dr. Uchiyama's great qualities include his wide range of ideas and knowledge of treatment approaches, his deep knowledge of both Western and Eastern medicine, but perhaps his greatest driving force is his dedication to cats. Even when cleaning the sinuses, they adjust the length and thickness of the tube to minimize pain, and they communicate with the cat as they go through the treatment, so we can leave it to them with peace of mind. My cat is still undergoing treatment, and I plan to continue relying on them until he is completely cured.

My cat had a severe skin rash, so I came to this clinic for the first time.

Both the receptionist and the doctor were very kind, and they explained the tests and treatment options thoroughly. My cat is quite unruly at the hospital and causes a lot of trouble, but they didn't show any displeasure and treated her while encouraging her. I was very grateful.

Thank you very much.

My cat visited the hospital for the first time last week. I brought him in because he had bad breath, and during a health checkup, he was diagnosed with caudal stomatitis, which is why he is currently undergoing treatment. It's a difficult disease to cure, so we'll be discussing future treatment options with the doctor while monitoring his condition. The hospital has a very homey atmosphere, and I'm grateful to both Dr. Uchiyama and the nurses for treating my cat with such care and kindness. Pet illnesses can be worrying, but I can consult with them via LINE, and they're very considerate, so I feel at ease. I plan to continue using this hospital for health checkups, vaccinations, and other needs. If there are any treatments that are not available due to equipment limitations, they can be done at the main Harajuku hospital, and they share medical records.

The vet is very knowledgeable and caring. The nurses are also very kind to my dog, and my dog ​​has become very attached to them.

Being able to make appointments and view test results on my smartphone is extremely convenient. This is the best veterinary clinic I've ever been to.

I was looking for a new veterinary clinic and found this one through word of mouth. The doctor loves animals and was very attentive and caring. I felt at ease knowing that my pet was being examined and that they explained everything clearly. I would definitely like to come back here if anything comes up again.

My Chihuahua received excellent care at this clinic. A bump had appeared several months ago, and I was worried. My previous vet immediately suggested surgery, which made me anxious. So I searched for a good vet in Minato Ward and found this website, which led me to visit. It turned out to be the perfect choice. A kind female vet spent an hour carefully examining my dog, and determined it wasn't malignant, but a lipoma, so we decided to monitor it. She spoke to my dog ​​reassuringly, asking "Shall we listen now?" while using the stethoscope, and checked for periodontal disease and odor. She truly treats dogs with genuine affection.

As she studied at the University of Tokyo Graduate School, her explanations were logical and reassuring; for example, she explained, "If it were a malignant tumor, there would definitely be roots to draw nutrients, but those aren't visible." This put my mind at ease.

My dog ​​also received a Churu treat from the reception area for the first time, which helped him relax completely. The nurses were also very kind and pleasant. I would like to continue using this clinic's services in the future.
I had my cat examined with an ultrasound here today. The doctor and nurses were very kind! I would like to come again next time.

I had been going to a different hospital until now, but I came here for the first time after moving.

The doctor and nurses were very kind, which put me at ease.

Also, there was a waiting room specifically for cats, and the relaxing atmosphere was a great help.
We were both very nervous about going to the vet for the first time (my cat and I), but we were relieved by the very thorough and gentle examination. Thank you very much.

The vet was kind, gentle with my dog, and gave him a thorough examination. The doctor explained everything in detail. I'm grateful that they found the bronchitis before it got worse. My dog ​​was treated kindly and even got a treat, so he's in a good mood.

There is a waiting room just for cats, and the nurses are always talking to cats during the examination.

During the examination, the staff treated me with love and kindness, which made me feel at ease the whole time. They examined me very carefully and explained things in an easy-to-understand manner. I'm glad that my dog ​​also seems to like this hospital!
It was a very polite and reassuring place.
The doctor and staff were all cheerful and kind, and they listened to my concerns attentively and explained everything thoroughly, which made me feel very at ease. Thank you very much.

I only requested a grooming service, but they were very thorough and kind! I also received helpful advice, and I'm so glad I came here.

I'll definitely be back again.

Dr. Uchiyama and the nurses were very kind and gentle with my dog.

They explained the blood test results and daily care instructions in detail, which was very informative.

The clinic was very clean, and I would like to visit again.

They were very polite and explained things clearly.
They also responded appropriately to my restless child.
I have a regular doctor, but I was looking for another hospital that was open on closed days, so I came here and thought this was a good choice.
They provide very kind and thorough explanations.

I visited for a health checkup.

The doctor and nurses were all kind and gentle. Their explanations were easy to understand.

There was an all-you-can-eat snack buffet! My dog ​​was thrilled! 😊

The doctor and nurses were very kind and provided excellent care.

The doctors and nurses were all kind and polite.

I will continue to use this facility in the future.
The veterinarians and staff were all filled with love for animals, so I felt at ease.
I visited for a checkup, and there was no waiting time after my scheduled appointment. I'm also very satisfied with the service.
The doctors and nurses were kind, and their explanations were thorough, so I'm glad I went.

I used their services for a health checkup.

Besides the checkup, they also gave me advice on things I was concerned about in my daily life, and I was relieved to find out that there didn't seem to be any problems.

After the checkup, my dog ​​was given a treat in the waiting room, which made him happy.

Thank you very much!

Since the hospital is newly opened, I dropped in for a health checkup.

Above all, the explanation of the health checkup results was very easy to understand, which put me at ease. 

There is a paid parking lot below the hospital, so it is easy to get to by car.

This was my first time using their services, and the doctor and staff were all very kind and gentle with my cat. They listened carefully to even the smallest concerns and examined my cat thoroughly. It's a veterinary hospital where you can leave your pet with peace of mind.

The hospital was very clean, and there was a waiting room specifically for cats, creating a relaxing atmosphere. My cat is easily frightened, but the quiet and calm environment allowed her to spend her time there without stress.

Thank you so much for everything. My cat was treated by a wonderful doctor. The doctor patiently addressed even the difficult-to-diagnose symptoms, and thanks to the thorough examination and tests, my cat has made a remarkable recovery. The doctor's meticulous care and the kindness of the staff created a reassuring atmosphere for my cat. I would definitely like to use their services again if needed in the future. This is a trustworthy hospital.

I would never be disappointed with this clinic as our regular vet. They also offer free routine grooming, which is very considerate!
